_comment: The documentation toolchain, kept out of the application's dependency tree on purpose. VitePress 1.x pins an older Vite than the app uses, which produced a permanent peer-dependency conflict and pulled a known-vulnerable esbuild into every `npm install` in the repository. None of it ever shipped - the Dockerfile removes the whole toolchain and public/build is committed - but a security product should not carry a high-severity advisory in its public tree to build a documentation site. Building the docs is now `cd docs && npm ci && npm run build`, and the application's own `npm audit` is clean enough to gate CI on.
